name: Chorroha
source:
“Chorroha” means “crossroads” in Uzbek and Tajik, symbolizing the paths, choices, and destinies that intersect throughout this visual novel.

The story follows Timur and Kamila, two high school graduates facing an important crossroads in their lives. Each character has four story routes and four possible endings.
translation:
“Chorroha”在乌兹别克语与塔吉克语中意为“十字路口”，象征着在这部视觉小说中彼此交汇的道路、抉择与命运。

故事围绕铁木尔与卡米拉两名站在人生重要十字路口的高中毕业生展开。每位角色均拥有四条故事路线与四种可能结局。
